t: Fortress 9Ltr Sage Shed & Fence Stain is a high-performance, water-based wood stain engineered for robust outdoor timber protection and colouring. This durable sage wood stain is ideal for garden timber, including exterior sheds and fences, offering essential defence against moisture ingress and enhancing aesthetic appeal. Its quick-drying formulation becomes showerproof in just one hour, allowing for quicker project completion and minimising disruption on site. With low odour and easy-to-clean properties, application is straightforward. A single 9Ltr container provides excellent coverage for extensive garden wood treatment.
